title: eriogonum nudum subsp. pauciflorum
intro: Eriogonum nudum subsp. pauciflorum, commonly known as Kannah Creek buckwheat, is a plant species in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown it to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum nudum subsp. pauciflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms and cancer cells.
